title: embody vs Eden vs altRx: Online GLP-1 Providers Compared (Not Just Price)
description:
How the top three online GLP-1 providers on TreatmentsHub compare on what matters beyond price: commitment, medication options, support and shipping.

What we compared:
• embody: month-to-month, no contract; compounded medications only; dedicated nursing team and 1:1 medical support; free 1-2 day shipping
• Eden: one all-inclusive price, no membership or long-term plans; compounded only; doctor-guided care with 24/7 human support
• altRx: monthly, no contract; brand-name Zepbound and Wegovy options too; clinician-guided (physician, PA or NP); free shipping in about 5-7 days

Provider details as listed in our reviews (updated Sep-Oct 2026). Confirm current terms on each provider's site.

Full guide: https://www.treatmentshub.com/weight-loss
The comparison page this video is based on was reviewed for medical accuracy by Francheska Capistrano, RMT, MPH (medical content reviewer) on Oct 30, 2026.
